'''Premiere - Virtual Set 13 Draft''' is a draft format on [[GEMP]] using cards from [[Premiere]] through Virtual Set 13. The Players Committee Cube page calls it "GEMP - Basic Prem-V13 Draft" and describes it as a basic draft with no objectives or add-on cards.<ref name="pc-cube" /> GEMP's draft list points this type to <code>/draft/basic_premv13_draft.json</code>.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="drafts" />

* '''Type:''' booster draft (GEMP cube draft)
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee Cube page; GEMP draft file
* '''Card pool:''' Premiere through Virtual Set 13 cards; 10 fixed cards and 54 picks per side
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Premiere - Virtual Set 13 Draft'' (<code>basic_premv13_draft</code>) on play.swccg.com; on the Players Committee GEMP the same draft file is played under the [[Cube]] format<ref name="pc-v13" />

== Card pool ==
For each side a player gets 10 fixed cards and drafts 54 cards from a list of 290.<ref name="v13" /><ref name="pc-cube" />
* '''Dark Side fixed cards:''' ''Rendili'', ''Cloud City: Downtown Plaza'', ''Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay)'', ''Fondor'', ''Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber'', ''Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay'', ''Tatooine'', ''Tatooine: Mos Espa'', ''Executor: Docking Bay'', ''Prepared Defenses''.<ref name="v13" /><ref name="pc-cube" /><ref name="cardjson" />
* '''Light Side fixed cards:''' ''Bespin'', ''Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay)'', ''Cloud City: Guest Quarters'', ''Mon Calamari'', ''Tatooine: Docking Bay 94'', ''Tatooine: Cantina'', ''Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm'' (V), ''Malastare'', ''Home One: Docking Bay'', ''Heading For The Medical Frigate''.<ref name="v13" /><ref name="pc-cube" /><ref name="cardjson" />
The Cube page lists every draftable card. Players build decks from the 64 cards per side.<ref name="pc-cube" />

=== How picks work ===
GEMP shuffles each side's pick list and offers a shrinking "pack": 9 cards, then 8, down to 1, then 9 again, six times over 54 picks. A card already in the player's pool is not offered again, and a picked card brings any add-on cards listed for it.<ref name="dcb" /><ref name="v13" />

=== Deck rules ===
On play.swccg.com the format sets a deck size of 40 cards and is not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" /> The Players Committee code's draft file names its <code>cube</code> format instead, which sets 45 cards.<ref name="pc-v13" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> The format's set list is the same as [[Open]]; the drafted pool limits what a player can use.<ref name="gemp" />

== History ==
The draft is one of the cubes on the Players Committee Cube page, which links older cubes, versions 1 to 7, from 2014 to 2020.<ref name="pc-cube" /> The Players Committee GEMP code has the same draft file under its Cube format; play.swccg.com gave it its own format.<ref name="pc-v13" /><ref name="v13" /><ref name="gemp" /> No source gives who built this cube or when, and no event result is recorded.
